name: list_projects
description:
List all indexed projects (name, root, stats). Call this first when
    unsure which project to target; other tools take project=<name>.

name: search
description:
Hybrid semantic + keyword search over the indexed codebase.
    Use INSTEAD of reading whole files when looking for where something is
    implemented or how it works. Query in the vocabulary the code uses, not
    the vocabulary of the question: "verify session token" finds what "is this
    endpoint protected" misses. Start with the five-result default and only
    request more when a concrete evidence gap remains. project: registry name
    or path (optional when only one project is indexed).

    Pass a LIST of related questions to get one source-free evidence bundle
    covering all of them, with a `fetch_targets` list to hand unchanged to a
    single expand call before searching again. max_bytes bounds that bundle
    and is ignored for a single query.

    select='model' asks a local model to choose which leads answer a LIST
    query, instead of the built-in rules. It is per-call because the trade
    differs per question: a paraphrase is worth a second of latency, an
    exact symbol name is not. Absent or slow, the rules answer and the
    `selector` block in the response says which ran.

    max_bytes caps the response for a caller working to a budget: results
    are dropped from the end, best kept, and the response says how many were
    withheld and how to ask for them. 0, the default, means no cap. It has
    always bounded a LIST query's bundle and now bounds a single query too.

    `path` narrows the search to a subtree ("packages/core"), so semantic
    intent can be anchored to where the answer must live instead of ranking
    the whole repository and discarding most of it.

    If the index is behind the working tree the response carries a
    `freshness` block and a refresh is dispatched in the background. Pass
    force_fresh=True right after edits to wait briefly for that refresh.

name: context
description:
360-degree view of a symbol: definition location, incoming edges (what
    depends on it), outgoing edges (what it depends on), and the symbol's own
    source. detail='signature' returns just the declaration, 'minimal' adds
    the doc comment, 'full' (default) returns the whole body.
    detail='structure' returns the control skeleton instead of source — each
    statement's line, its nesting depth, and the construct opening its
    enclosing block — for deciding whether a check actually runs rather than
    merely appears. A language with no grammar abstains by name.
    confidence_min hides edges resolved only by name match (<=0.6), which are
    guesses with no receiver type behind them; when any are hidden the
    response says how many and how to ask for them. Pass 0.0 to see them.

name: impact
description:
Blast-radius analysis before modifying a symbol. direction='upstream'
    lists what depends on it (will break); 'downstream' lists what it uses;
    'both' walks the neighbourhood around the given roots without returning
    source, for deciding which few symbols to expand. Depth 1 = direct,
    deeper = transitive. Accepts a list of symbols: 'both' treats them as one
    frontier, a direction reports on each. confidence_min applies to 'both'.

name: map
description:
PageRank-ranked broad-orientation map, capped at 12 files and packed
    to a token budget. Do not call for a focused symbol, file, or behavior
    question. Pass focus=["auth", "api/"] whenever the relevant area is known.

name: expand
description:
Source code for a symbol (name or qualified name) or a chunk id from
    search results. Use after search/context/map when you need the
    implementation, INSTEAD of reading the whole file. detail='signature'
    returns just the declaration, 'minimal' adds the doc comment, 'full'
    (default) returns the whole body -- step down when you only need shape.

    Pass a LIST (up to 12 targets, e.g. search's fetch_targets unchanged) to
    fetch them in one call and avoid repair-search round trips. If the byte
    budget omits targets the response carries a `recovery` pointer -- retry
    with detail='minimal' before splitting the batch.

name: grep
description:
Exact text search over the indexed project (ripgrep semantics).

    Semantic search retrieves whole symbols, so text that is not inside a
    function or class -- top-level tables like `const std::vector<T> x = {...}`,
    flag strings, error messages, magic constants -- is not reachable through
    `search`. Use this when you know the literal characters you are looking for
    and `search` returned only the callers. `path` narrows to a subdirectory;
    `literal=True` disables regex metacharacters.

name: detect_changes
description:
Pre-commit blast radius: maps uncommitted git changes to symbols and
    lists upstream callers that may break, with risk level. Call before
    committing multi-file or shared-code changes. base='' compares working
    tree; pass a ref like 'main' to compare against a branch.

name: reindex
description:
Refresh the index. Merkle-diff based: only changed files are
    re-processed. force=True rebuilds everything.
